subject: fractalai-pqc-conformance
finding: A third party implemented CSOAI A2A signed-receipts/v1 in a PQC conformance suite
author: johnromo79
significance: FIRST third-party standards adoption anywhere in the estate
honest_sentence: FractalAI's PQC conformance suite implements CSOAI A2A signed-receipts/v1 as one of 7 interop profiles. First external standards adoption. The npm package exists and is downloadable.
